The published npm tarballs declare `"license": "MIT"` but do not include a LICENSE file. Before distributing a release, copy the LICENSE text from the upstream repository at the pinned commit into this directory (tracked in `docs/spec/status.md`).

`pnpm pi:version` verifies the installed versions and license fields against this pin.
